pr_title: drivers: serial: fix potential overflow in fifo_fill and fifo_read
pr_body:
try to fix issue #80599 , a error of type transform(?) in serial drivers. For `fifo_read` it may cause wrong read data if parameter `size` is over 255, while endless looping for `fifo_fill`, if uart is running faster than cpu.

Fixes #80599

issue_context.title: a overflow loop may happens when `uart_stm32_fifo_read_visitor` .
issue_context.body:
<!--
**Notes**
Github Discussions (https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/discussions)
are available to first verify that the issue is a genuine Zephyr bug and not a
consequence of Zephyr services misuse.

This issue list is only for bugs in the main Zephyr code base
(https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/). If the bug is for a project
fork (such as NCS) specific feature, please open an issue in the fork project
instead.
-->
the type of uint8_t for `num_tx` may overflow while `size` can be over 256, if the freq of cpu is relative low and uart baudrate is high, it may be stuck. the problem also appears in at least `uart_stm32_fifo_fill`.

**Describe the bug**
<!--
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

Please also mention any information which could help others to understand
the problem you're facing:
 - What target platform are you using?
 - What have you tried to diagnose or workaround this issue?
 - Is this a regression? If yes, have you been able to "git bisect" it to a
   specific commit?
 - ...
-->
in zephyr/drivers/serial/uart_stm32.c, one of the function uart_stm32_fifo_read_visitor is:
```c
static int uart_stm32_fifo_read_visitor(const struct device *dev, void *rx_data, const int size,
					fifo_read_fn read_fn)
{
	const struct uart_stm32_config *config = dev->config;
	USART_TypeDef *usart = config->usart;
	uint8_t num_rx = 0U;

	while ((size - num_rx > 0) && LL_USART_IsActiveFlag_RXNE(usart)) {
		/* RXNE flag will be cleared upon read from DR|RDR register */

		read_fn(usart, rx_data, num_rx);
		num_rx++;

		/* Clear overrun error flag */
		if (LL_USART_IsActiveFlag_ORE(usart)) {
			LL_USART_ClearFlag_ORE(usart);
			/*
			 * On stm32 F4X, F1X, and F2X, the RXNE flag is affected (cleared) by
			 * the uart_err_check function call (on errors flags clearing)
			 */
		}
	}

	return num_rx;
}

```
**To Reproduce**
<!--
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. mkdir build; cd build
2. cmake -DBOARD=board\_xyz
3. make
4. See error
-->

just use the uart_stm32.

**Expected behavior**
<!--
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
-->

the overflow may happens in `uart_stm32_fifo_read_visitor` then `rxdata` will be wrong, and it will also cause more loops for uart read if size is large than 255.

**Impact**
<!--
What impact does this issue have on your progress (e.g., annoyance, showstopper)
-->
bad data in rxdata, or loop in fifo_read

**Environment (please complete the following information):**

 - OS: Linux
 - Toolchain: arm-gcc-none-eabi
comments:
Hi @ken4647! We appreciate you submitting your first issue for our open-source project. 🌟

Even though I'm a bot, I can assure you that the whole community is genuinely grateful for your time and effort. 🤖💙
why the type of  `num_rx` is `uint8_t` rather than `int` (as the return value is `int`)?

review_comments: The typedef `fifo_fill_fn` takes a `uint8_t` for third parameter, but that should also be changed by an `int`, that impacts the functions `fifo_fill_with_u8` and `fifo_fill_with_u16` as well.
The typedef `fifo_read_fn` takes a `uint8_t` for third parameter, but that should also be changed by an `int`, that impacts the functions `fifo_read_with_u8` and `fifo_read_with_u16` as well.
I got it, and I will check for other drivers.

I have checked all codes related to the 15 serial drivers. There is only STM32's serial driver that has such impacts, while others are use the variable `num_tx` or `num_rx`  only as local variable, without transferring them to other codes.
